tldr: Uranus through the 1st house disrupts your body, identity, confidence, and first response to life.
body:
When Uranus moves through your 1st house, it interrupts the usual pattern around your body, identity, energy, appearance, confidence, and the way you show up. You may feel more aware of how you are coming across, how much energy you have, and whether your outer life still matches who you feel yourself becoming.

You may need more space, honesty, freedom, experimentation, or a break from the old setup. It can help you see where the current pattern has become too small or too false.

The useful side is that this timing can make the next honest move easier to see. This is useful for noticing what your presence is already saying before you explain anything.

The caution: Watch for changing everything just to get relief from one pressure point. The risk is becoming too focused on how you are perceived and missing what your body is telling you.

Uranus moves through this house for a long chapter. Give change room without throwing away the parts of life that still matter.
